chapter: Opening and the Budweiser Dance Hall
title: Who took over after the 1942 break-up, and Papadie the drummer
summary: Zander asks about Johnny Cicero; Rene says others took over after the trouble in 1942, and Russell identifies the drummer Papadie as surnamed Foster.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Did Johnny Cicero ever play with you there?
No, Johnny Cicero played spot jobs.
I heard him there one time too about 1942. I wondered if he took.

I think they must have took over because I know they left me after the scrummage. Yeah, yeah, yeah. In 42 that's the time they must have took over. Oh yeah this other little boy Papadie called him. He went back there. They had another section because after that scrummage happened I don't know.
You never did know his real name? Foster, I do.
Foster, that's his name. Is he any relation to Earl Foster? No, no, no relative at all. Just Papad Foster? No, it's not a. Not Chy B.
